description:
Read a module's automations: the ones that run when an activity is submitted, and the schedules that run one on each entry they match. Workspace admins only.

- An activity's automation: { id, name, activity, enabled, before, after, tests }. `before` and `after` are graphs ({ blocks }) in display names, run before and after the submit is saved.
- A schedule: { id, name, schedule, filter, execution, run, enabled }, with its schedule as a sentence.
- Scripts read "(script hidden)": send one back unchanged to keep the stored script. Any automation can be edited from its read-back and sent back to save_automation.
- `tests` are its stored tests in full (steps, expect, as). Switching it on needs at least one, all passing.
- `otherTriggers` (notifications, digests, timed triggers) are listed by name: they are changed in the Studio.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID for this call. The MCP keeps no workspace between calls, so pass it every time; omit only when INISTATE_WORKSPACE_ID is configured.

name: get_module_automations
